Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

This Cookie Policy explains how A.A.D Transport & Recovery uses cookies and similar tracking technologies on our website. By continuing to use our website, you agree to the placement of cookies on your device in accordance with this Cookie Policy.

1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help improve the user experience by remembering your preferences, enabling certain functionalities, and allowing us to analyse website traffic.

2. Types of Cookies We Use

  • Necessary Cookies: These cookies are essential for the website to function properly.
  • Performance Cookies: These cookies collect information about how visitors interact with our website, including pages visited and time spent, allowing us to improve the site.
  • Functionality Cookies: These cookies remember your preferences to enhance your browsing experience.
  • Analytical Cookies: Our website uses Google Analytics cookies to help us understand visitor interactions, such as which pages are visited most often and how long users stay on each page.

3. Google Analytics

Our website uses Google Analytics to analyse website traffic and improve site performance. Google Analytics cookies track and report user interactions, helping us understand how visitors use our site. For more information on how Google processes data, please visit Google’s Privacy Policy.

If you prefer not to be tracked by Google Analytics, you can install the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on.

4. Managing Cookies

You can control the use of cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to view, manage, delete, and block cookies for a website. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our website.

To learn more about cookies and how to manage them, visit www.aboutcookies.org or www.allaboutcookies.org.

5. Changes to This Cookie Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page, so please review this policy periodically to stay informed about our use of cookies.

6. Contact Us

For any questions regarding this Cookie Policy, please contact us:

Phone: 07771 004242
